en.headline: Tai Po Baptist Public School opens new Fu Shin Estate campus
en.dek: Nearly 600 pupils displaced after the Wang Fuk Court fire reunite at renovated premises after months at two temporary sites; Education Secretary Christine Choi officiated at the opening.
body: Tai Po Baptist Public School opened its new premises at Fu Shin Estate on Saturday, reuniting nearly 600 pupils and teachers who had been split across two temporary sites after the Wang Fuk Court fire forced the original campus to close.

The Education Bureau spent about HK$43.6 million refurbishing the former CCC Kei Ching Primary School site, including classrooms, toilets, the assembly hall, basketball court, electrical systems, air-conditioning and the lift. A further one-off grant of HK$1 million covered relocation expenses.

Secretary for Education Christine Choi Yuk-lin officiated at the opening ceremony. She said the relocation was not merely a change of location but a significant moment for teachers and students to reunite and embark on a new page together in a safe and stable learning environment.

zh.headline: 大埔浸信會公立學校富善邨新校舍啟用
zh.dek: 宏福苑火災後近600名師生分散兩處臨時校舍數月，周六於富善邨新校舍重聚，教育局局長蔡若蓮主持開幕。
body: 大埔浸信會公立學校周六於富善邨新校舍舉行開幕典禮，近600名因宏福苑火災而分散兩處臨時校舍的師生重聚一堂。
教育局斥資約4,360萬元翻新前中華基督教會基正小學舊址，包括課室、洗手間、禮堂、籃球場、電力及冷氣系統，以及升降機等，另撥出100萬元一筆過津貼支援搬遷。
教育局局長蔡若蓮主持開幕儀式時表示，遷校不單是地點轉變，更是師生重聚、共同開啟新一頁的重要時刻，新校舍為師生提供安全穩定的學習環境。
